name: modbee-gsm
description: Function blocks that put a cellular modem inside an OpenPLC program: the ModBee GSM HAT on a Node UIO, or a USB modem on the Runtime. One block brings the modem up and keeps it up - power, SIM, network, data - and recovers it by itself; the others send and receive SMS, open a TCP or TLS socket, read the signal, the network time and a GNSS fix, and send any AT command. MQTT_CLIENT uses the same modem with TRANSPORT := MQTT_CELLULAR. Every connection setting is a pin, so it can come from a retained variable. Nothing here blocks a scan.
